A custom data_as_elements list names the elements to convert

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{
		DataAsElements: []string{`section`},
	}
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<div><section data-as="p">First</section><section data-as="p">Second</section></div>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
